fidelity: F2a — Bidirectional Electrochemical Model with Thermal ODE
source: Springer et al. (1991) J. Electrochem. Soc. 138(8) 2334; Amphlett et al. (1995) J. Electrochem. Soc. 142(1) 1; Marangio et al. (2009) Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 34 1143; Barbir (2005) PEM Fuel Cells: Theory and Practice; Doddathimmaiah & Andrews (2009) Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 34 8157 (URFC unitised regenerative model)
note: Unitised regenerative PEM fuel cell. Convention: j > 0 = discharge (fuel-cell mode, V = E - eta); j < 0 = charge (electrolysis mode, V = E + eta). Same membrane-electrode assembly used in both modes; separate exchange-current densities and limiting currents per mode reflect the asymmetry of the bifunctional catalyst (Doddathimmaiah & Andrews 2009).
